basic_details.job_title: Kallakurichi District Social Welfare Member Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Kallakurichi district (Juvenile Justice Board) has invited applications for 1 Social Welfare Member post under the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 rules. Applications go by post to the Director, Department of Child Welfare and Special Services, First Floor, CMDA Tower II, Gandhi Irwin Road, Egmore, Chennai - 600008, and must reach there by 5.00 PM on 22 December 2026. The post is on honorarium basis and is not a government post.

post_wise_qualification.post_name: Social Welfare Member, Juvenile Justice Board, Kallakurichi

qualification.details: Qualification and experience: the applicant must have been engaged in activities relating to child health, education or welfare for at least 7 years, OR be a practising professional with a degree in child psychology, psychiatry, social work, sociology or law. Age: not less than 35 years and not having completed 65 years. No relaxation is mentioned, and no cut-off date for counting age is printed. Nature of the post: appointment is on honorarium basis, and the notice says the post is not a government post. | Candidates should refer to the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

selection_process: The notice says the appointment will be made on the basis of qualification and experience. No written test or interview is described.
important_instructions: The application must reach the Chennai office within the stipulated time; it is sent by post. The Social Welfare Member post is not a government service post and the appointment is on honorarium basis. The District Collector has stated that the government's decision on this matter is final.

content_sections.heading: About Kallakurichi District Social Welfare Member
content_sections.text: The Social Welfare Member is a member of the Juvenile Justice Board constituted in Kallakurichi district under the rules of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015. The notice is a press release of the District Public Relations Office, Kallakurichi, and states that the District Collector, Tmt. J.E. Padmaja, IAS, has announced it.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the completed application by post to: Director, Department of Child Welfare and Special Services, First Floor, CMDA Tower II, Gandhi Irwin Road, Egmore, Chennai - 600008. The application must reach this office by 5.00 PM on 22 December 2026; the notice asks that completed applications reach the office by post within the stipulated time. Application form: available at the Kallakurichi District Child Protection Unit (Room No. 601), 6th floor, Kallakurichi District Collectorate. The form can also be downloaded from https://kallakurichi.nic.in or https://dsdcpimms.tn.gov.in . The notice does not mention an envelope superscription or a specific postal mode.

faq.question: Q1. How many Social Welfare Member posts are vacant in Kallakurichi?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Social Welfare Member on the Juvenile Justice Board in Kallakurichi district.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Chennai office by 5.00 PM on 22 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Social Welfare Member?
faq.answer: The applicant must have been engaged in child health, education or welfare activities for at least 7 years, or be a practising professional with a degree in child psychology, psychiatry, social work, sociology or law.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The applicant must be not less than 35 years and must not have completed 65 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Get the form from the District Child Protection Unit (Room No. 601) at the Kallakurichi Collectorate or download it from kallakurichi.nic.in or dsdcpimms.tn.gov.in, then send it by post to the Director, Department of Child Welfare and Special Services, Chennai.

faq.question: Q6. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Send it to the Director, Department of Child Welfare and Special Services, First Floor, CMDA Tower II, Gandhi Irwin Road, Egmore, Chennai - 600008.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Social Welfare Member post a government job?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the appointment is on honorarium basis and the post is not a government service post.

faq.question: Q8. How will the Social Welfare Member be selected?
faq.answer: The appointment will be made on the basis of qualification and experience, according to the notice.
